card.name: Words just before a stress-related term
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens, or partway through a word, where the next word could plausibly start with 'st' or 'stress' (such as stress, stasis, steroid, stable). It fires in drug-label and general web text.

modes.label: Bracket or punctuation before a st- word
modes.description: An opening parenthesis, comma or colon sits just before a word starting with St or related terms.

modes.label: Linking word before a stress-like noun
modes.description: A short word like an, of or were appears where a stress or stress-related noun could come next.

modes.label: Inside radionuclide
modes.description: The final piece of the word radionuclide, followed by a verb phrase.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting 'stress' and related words, and away from tokens beginning with 'St'.
